title: Mission
description: Why I want to build aerospace software — and help make human life multi-planetary.

sections.heading: Software for a multi-planetary future.
sections.text: After finishing an accelerated degree well ahead of my year, I’m pursuing a career in **aerospace software** — work that directly supports launch-based missions and the goal of making human life multi-planetary.

sections.heading: What pulls me in
sections.body:
### Aerospace
I’m interested in pursuing work that directly supports an aerospace, launch-based mission — and I’m eager to help with the mission of making human life multi-planetary.

### Computer architecture
I like writing optimized software that works close to the hardware. Right now I’m researching how to develop games for the original Nintendo Game Boy.
